name: Tesseract RAPID
description: Emit ABB RAPID from one exact native Tesseract CompositeInstruction without converting or saving it.

inputParameters.name: program
inputParameters.description: Exact native tesseract_robotics CompositeInstruction. Planning wrappers and COMPAS trajectories are rejected.

inputParameters.name: profile_maps
inputParameters.description: Native RAPID profile maps. Duplicate Tesseract profile names fail instead of using connection order.

inputParameters.name: module_name
inputParameters.description: ABB RAPID module name. Defaults to main_program.

inputParameters.name: procedure_name
inputParameters.description: ABB RAPID procedure name. Defaults to main.

outputParameters.name: rapid_program
outputParameters.description: Immutable RapidProgram retaining the exact input CompositeInstruction, emitted source, names, versions, and SHA-256 identity.

outputParameters.name: source
outputParameters.description: Exact source returned by Tesseract nanobind's native RAPID emitter.

outputParameters.name: program_id
outputParameters.description: SHA-256 identity covering exact source, names, schema, COMPAS FAB, and nanobind versions.
